Caitlyn.watch: Stepping on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap roots you and leaves you vulnerable to heavy damage from Caitlyn P Headshot's increased range. Watch for traps in brush and narrow paths, and change your approach route. Dodge Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker from behind your minions so they take the first hit.
Caitlyn.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Caitlyn deals mainly physical damage, and Aphelios has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Caitlyn.fight: When Aphelios has Calibrum, use marks from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to trade while keeping your distance. Avoid direct fights because your immediate damage is low.
Caitlyn.laning: Early on, do not overextend and give up kills, and collect CS even under your turret. Poke with Calibrum, clear waves with Infernum, and use Gravitum's root to follow up when your support or jungler engages. With an unfavorable weapon combination, check the next weapon shown by Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and manage your ammo.
Caitlyn.combo: Even when using Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil to root multiple enemies, first use Aphelios W Phase to make Gravitum your main weapon.
Caitlyn.escape: Avoid paths covered by Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, and do not engage while rooted by a trap.
Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn is strong in the early lane, so farm while limiting your losses. Caitlyn becomes relatively weaker over time, and Aphelios can look for fights after getting items.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Position behind your frontline and attack according to your current weapon combination. Slow multiple enemies with Gravitum, then root them with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites, or use Infernum to deal area damage to grouped enemies. Avoid narrow paths where Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap may be placed. If an ally is targeted by Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole, block the bullet in its path.

Draven.watch: Avoid early trades when Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axe axes active. Draven E Stand Aside knocks you aside and slows you, so do not force an approach while it is available. Dodge Draven R Whirling Death on its return path too, and move out of range if your health is low.
Draven.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor. Draven deals mainly physical damage, and Aphelios has relatively low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Draven.fight: Do not fight when Draven has two axes; look for trades when he has one or none. Aim Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites at the spot where an axe will land, forcing Draven to take the hit or give up the axe. Slow him with Gravitum, then root him so he cannot catch it.
Draven.laning: Early on, focus on farming without giving up kills, and manage your ammo with an unfavorable weapon combination. Keep your distance and poke with Calibrum, and clear waves with Infernum. If Draven steps forward, time Gravitum's root with your support's or jungler's engage.
Draven.combo: When Gravitum is your main weapon, slow Draven with a basic attack, then root him with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If Gravitum is your offhand weapon, bring it forward with Aphelios W Phase and use the same sequence. To root multiple enemies with Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil, make Gravitum your main weapon, land R, then follow with the root.
Draven.escape: Engage when Draven E Stand Aside is down and he has one axe or none. Draven has no way to create distance on his own, so close the gap, then use Gravitum's slow and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to stop him catching his axe.
Draven.phase: Early on, Draven's trades are strong when he has two axes, so Aphelios should farm while limiting his losses. In the mid game, look for fights after Aphelios gets items, and target Draven with your team when he is alone. In late teamfights, choose your role according to your weapon combination and attack from behind your frontline.
Draven.teamfight: Stand behind your frontline and aim abilities where Draven's axe will land. With Gravitum, use the slow and root to stop him catching it; with Infernum, deal area damage to grouped enemies. Before using Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil, make the weapon with the effect you want your main weapon.

Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley is a cone-shaped poke that applies a slow, so move sideways to dodge it. Ashe P Frost Shot refreshes its slow with every basic attack, so do not stay within her attack range for long. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, do not start a skirmish from outside vision. Change direction when dodging the arrow.
Ashe.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ashe deals mainly physical damage, and Aphelios has relatively low armor, so build armor first. If the enemy has a lot of immobilizing crowd control, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier.
Ashe.fight: Look for trades right after Ashe W Volley is used, and keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active. With Calibrum, use the mark from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to attack once more from afar and wear down her health. When you get a chance to reach Ashe, slow her with Gravitum, then root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.
Ashe.laning: Early on, farm while limiting your losses, and trade after dodging Ashe W Volley sideways. Poke with Calibrum and clear waves with Infernum to gain lane control. With Gravitum, add a root to your support's or jungler's engage; manage your ammo with an unfavorable weapon combination.
Ashe.combo: Slow Ashe with a Gravitum basic attack, then root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If Gravitum is your offhand weapon, make it your main weapon with Aphelios W Phase, then use Q. To follow Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil's slow with a root, use W to make Gravitum your main weapon before casting R.
Ashe.escape: The chance to close the gap comes after Ashe W Volley is used and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus ends. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is also down, there is less risk of being stunned. With Severum, you can use the movement speed increase from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to engage, but account for how you will get out afterward.
Ashe.phase: Early on, avoid Ashe W Volley poke and focus on farming without taking losses as Aphelios. The given information does not establish who is stronger in the mid or late game, so fight according to your weapon combination and whether Ashe has used her abilities.
Ashe.teamfight: Attack from behind your frontline, and do not force your way forward while slowed by Ashe P Frost Shot. With Gravitum, look to root multiple enemies using Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites or Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil. With Infernum, deal area damage to grouped enemies; do not force an engage if your weapon combination is unsuitable.

Jhin.watch: Jhin's final basic attack deals heavy damage, so back away when he has his last bullet. Right after being hit by Jhin's basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience, watch for the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish and move out of its line. At low health, dodge the shots from Jhin R Curtain Call, which grow stronger based on missing health.
Jhin.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor. Jhin deals mainly physical damage, and Aphelios has low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Jhin.fight: Try to trade while Jhin is reloading or after he has fired one or two shots; back away when he has his last bullet. With Calibrum, mark him using Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites and make an additional attack from long range. After closing the gap, apply Gravitum's slow, bring Gravitum forward as your main weapon with Aphelios W Phase, then root him with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.
Jhin.laning: Stand away from low health minions so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade does not grow stronger by bouncing off a target it kills. Poke with Calibrum, clear waves with Infernum, and add a Gravitum root to an ally's engage. Check the next weapon shown by Aphelios E Weapon Queue System; with an unfavorable combination, manage your ammo and do not force a fight.
Jhin.combo: Slow Jhin with a Gravitum basic attack. If needed, switch Gravitum to your main weapon with Aphelios W Phase, then root him with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Before using Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil, choose your main weapon with Aphelios W Phase. Choose Gravitum to follow an area slow with a root, or Infernum for area damage.
Jhin.escape: Jhin has no mobility ability to create distance on his own, so you have a chance to close the gap while he reloads or after Jhin W Deadly Flourish misses. Do not go in when he has his last bullet or when you could be rooted on a trap.
Jhin.phase: Afterward, Aphelios should look for fights once he has items, while considering both his weapon combination and Jhin's remaining bullets. The given information does not establish which champion is always stronger in the mid or late game.
Jhin.teamfight: Position behind your frontline. Use the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites with Gravitum, or area damage with Infernum. When approaching Jhin, let your frontline go in first and take Jhin W Deadly Flourish and his traps. Jhin R Curtain Call is more dangerous at low health, so dodge its shots. If someone must block one, the ally with the highest health percentage should do it.

Jinx.watch: Avoid the slow from Jinx W Zap! and the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers! When Jinx hits minions with rockets, nearby targets also take damage, so do not stand on top of minions. Do not stay within range of Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! when you have lost health.
Jinx.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Jinx deals mostly physical damage, and Aphelios has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Armor does not reduce the magic damage from Jinx E Flame Chompers!
Jinx.fight: Look for moments when Jinx is poking with rockets and has no minigun attack speed stacks. If Jinx E Flame Chompers! has missed or been used, and Jinx W Zap! has also missed, you have a chance to close the gap. If you have Gravitum, apply its slow, then root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites and attack.
Jinx.laning: Farm safely early on. Check Aphelios E Weapon Queue System, which shows your next weapon, and manage your ammo. With Calibrum, poke from a distance using the mark from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. With Infernum, clear the wave. With Gravitum, add a root to an ally's engage.
Jinx.combo: If you have Gravitum, slow Jinx with a basic attack, then root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If Gravitum is your off-hand weapon, bring it forward with Aphelios W Phase before using Q. When using Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil, first make Gravitum your main weapon with W, then follow R's slow with Q's root.
Jinx.escape: Go in when Jinx E Flame Chompers! has missed or been used. If Jinx W Zap! has also missed, you can close the gap without taking its slow. Do not start a fight right after an ally dies or a turret falls, because Jinx P Get Excited! activates.
Jinx.phase: From the mid game, once you have a core item, look for fights based on your weapon combination and whether Jinx E Flame Chompers! has been used. The provided material does not establish a universal advantage for either champion in the late game, so fight teamfights according to your weapon combination.
Jinx.teamfight: Position behind your frontline and watch for the slow from Jinx W Zap! and the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers! If you have Gravitum, follow the slow from Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil with the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If you have Infernum, deal area damage to grouped enemies. Do not start a new fight immediately after Jinx P Get Excited! activates.

Ezreal.watch: Minions can block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot for you, so move within the wave. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, briefly step out of range before his next basic attack or ability hits. When your health is low, retreat at an angle to avoid the straight path of Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.
Ezreal.build: Farm safely early and complete your core item first. Ezreal deals both physical and magic damage, so if you need resistances, do not build only one type.
Ezreal.fight: When you have Calibrum, trade while keeping your distance with the mark from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. After forcing Ezreal E Arcane Shift, catch him with Gravitum's slow and root to continue the fight.
Ezreal.laning: Keep minions between you and Ezreal to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, and move along the inside of the wave. Poke with Calibrum, clear the wave with Infernum, and add Gravitum's root to an ally's engage. If your weapon combination is unfavorable, do not force a fight; check your ammo and next weapon.
Ezreal.combo: First, make a short advance to force Ezreal E Arcane Shift. Bring out Gravitum as your main weapon, apply a slow with Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil, then root him with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If Gravitum is your off-hand weapon, switch to it first with Aphelios W Phase.
Ezreal.escape: The moment after Ezreal E Arcane Shift is used is your chance to engage. If Ezreal keeps landing Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, E Arcane Shift comes off cooldown sooner, so use Gravitum's slow and root to close the gap in the meantime.
Ezreal.phase: After that, look for fights when you have your core item and a suitable weapon combination. The material does not establish which champion is stronger in the early, mid, or late game.
Ezreal.teamfight: Attack from behind your frontline and avoid long-range poke exchanges with Ezreal. Once Ezreal E Arcane Shift is used, look for a root with Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil while Gravitum is your main weapon, followed by Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If you have Infernum, deal area damage to grouped enemies.

Kaisa.watch: If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, you may become a target for Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, so retreat toward your allies until the mark disappears. When stacks of Kai'Sa P Second Skin build up, low health makes you more vulnerable; wait out the stacks from outside her range. When taking Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, its missiles may concentrate on you if you are isolated, so stand near allied minions.
Kaisa.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against Kai'Sa's main damage and basic attacks. Armor does not reduce the magic damage from Kai'Sa P Second Skin or Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, so also get magic resistance and health if you need to survive longer.
Kaisa.fight: When you have Calibrum, trade while keeping your distance with the mark from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites, and avoid a head-on fight during this phase of low immediate damage. If Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is down, slow her with a Gravitum basic attack, switch weapons with Aphelios W Phase, then open the fight by rooting her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. After Kai'Sa uses R Killer Instinct to dive in, immobilize her while her shield remains and take her down with your allies.
Kaisa.laning: When you expect Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, do not stand alone away from the wave. After that, poke with Calibrum, clear the wave with Infernum, and add a Gravitum root when your support or jungler engages.
Kaisa.combo: Slow Kai'Sa with a Gravitum basic attack. If Gravitum is your off-hand weapon, make it your main weapon with Aphelios W Phase, then root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. In a fight with several grouped enemies, make Gravitum your main weapon with Aphelios W Phase, land Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil for an area slow, then follow with a root. When you need to deal damage across a wide area, make Infernum your main weapon and use Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil.
Kaisa.escape: At that point, apply Gravitum's slow and root Kai'Sa with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to give her less room to escape.
Kaisa.phase: In the mid game, look for fights once Aphelios has his items, and take advantage of times when Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is down. In the late game, check your weapon combination rather than assuming either side is stronger, and fight behind your frontline to prepare for Kai'Sa's engage.
Kaisa.teamfight: Position behind your frontline. If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, retreat to deny her an angle for Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct. Kai'Sa E Supercharge can let her disappear on a flank, so place a Control Ward in side bushes and approach paths before a fight. If Kai'Sa dives in, immobilize her using Gravitum with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites or Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil. When you have Infernum, deal area damage to grouped enemies.

KogMaw.watch: While Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, keep your distance until it ends: it extends his range and adds damage based on maximum health to his basic attacks. Block Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle with a minion or dodge sideways. If it hits you, do not get close while your armor and magic resistance are reduced. When your health is low, avoid Kog'Maw R Living Artillery and recover out of vision. After killing Kog'Maw, move away from his body to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.build: Farm while minimizing losses early, then look for fights after completing a core item. If you need defensive stats, build magic resistance first against Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. Armor also helps against the physical damage from basic attacks, but avoid building only health because of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
KogMaw.fight: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends, trade while keeping your distance with Calibrum's marked attacks. With Gravitum, apply its slow, then use the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to follow an ally's engage. Kog'Maw has no dash, so once he is rooted, close the gap and attack with your allies.
KogMaw.laning: With Calibrum, use marks to poke without getting close. With Infernum, clear the wave to gain lane control. With Gravitum, add a root to your support's or jungler's engage to target Kog'Maw, who has no mobility ability. Check the next weapon shown by Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and your remaining ammo to prepare a suitable combination for the next fight.
KogMaw.combo: If Gravitum is your off-hand weapon, bring it out as your main weapon with Aphelios W Phase. Then slow Kog'Maw with a basic attack and root him with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.
KogMaw.escape: Go in after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and you have avoided the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. Kog'Maw has no ability to create distance on his own, so catch him during this window with Gravitum's slow and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.
KogMaw.phase: Early on, Aphelios should focus on farming without taking losses, then look for fights from the mid game once he has a core item. Kog'Maw gets stronger over time, so pressure objectives and turrets in the early and mid game to bring the game to a quicker finish. In the late game, as Kog'Maw grows stronger, do not force a fight with an unfavorable weapon combination.
KogMaw.teamfight: Position behind your frontline and watch for Kog'Maw's long-range attacks while Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active. If you have Gravitum, root Kog'Maw with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites or follow Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil with a root, and target him with your allies since he has no mobility ability. With Infernum, deal area damage to grouped enemies. If you kill Kog'Maw, move back to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.

Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and reaches beyond its displayed range, so avoid lining up behind a minion Lucian is farming. After Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, watch for his explosive opening combo. When Lucian R The Culling starts, sidestep instead of running straight back. If the enemy support shields or heals Lucian, or one of your allies is immobilized, step back to avoid his next two empowered shots.
Lucian.build: Lucian deals mainly physical damage, and Aphelios has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor for early survival and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Lucian.fight: Avoid Lucian's opening combo, then extend the fight once his abilities are down. Right after Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, use Aphelios W Phase to make Gravitum your main weapon. Slow him, then look for a root with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.
Lucian.laning: Farm safely early. Check the next weapon shown by Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and prepare the combination you will have when a fight starts. With Calibrum, poke using marks from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites without moving in, and avoid a direct fight. With Infernum, clear the wave. With Gravitum, add a root when your support or jungler engages.
Lucian.combo: Once Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down, use Aphelios W Phase to make Gravitum your main weapon. Slow him with a Gravitum basic attack, then root him with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If you can catch multiple enemies, keep Gravitum as your main weapon and hit Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil for an area slow, then follow with a root.
Lucian.escape: Engage right after you force Lucian E Relentless Pursuit; that is your window to catch him. If an ally is immobilized or Lucian's next two shots are empowered, back off instead of trading damage.
Lucian.phase: Early on, watch for Lucian's explosive opening combo and prioritize farming as Aphelios. In the mid and late game, look for fights when you have items and a suitable weapon combination. The available information does not establish which champion is stronger.
Lucian.teamfight: Attack from behind your frontline and watch where Lucian can enter with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit. With Gravitum, use the slow from Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to lock down multiple enemies. With Infernum, deal area damage to grouped enemies. Do not force your way forward when your weapon combination is unsuitable.

Kalista.watch: Kalista P Martial Poise lets her leap with every basic attack, so anticipate when each leap will start. Kalista E Rend deals its damage after spears have stacked; if several spears are lodged in you, stop fighting and retreat until they disappear. Kalista R Fate's Call can launch her support at you, so spread out when the support moves next to Kalista.
Kalista.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to withstand Kalista's mainly physical damage early. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and prioritize armor. Keep in mind that armor does not reduce the maximum health based magic damage from Kalista W Sentinel.
Kalista.fight: With Calibrum, use marks from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to keep your distance while trading damage. With Gravitum, apply a slow as Kalista starts a basic attack, then root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to create a chance to stop her leap. Focus on farming early as Aphelios and look for fights after you have your core items.
Kalista.laning: Do not take Kalista's basic attacks and stacks from Kalista E Rend for long. If needed, retreat behind a bush or wall to break vision. Poke with Calibrum and clear waves with Infernum. With Gravitum, add a root when your support or jungler engages. When your weapon combination is unfavorable, manage your ammo and avoid forcing a fight.
Kalista.combo: Before a fight, use Aphelios W Phase to make Gravitum your main weapon. Slow Kalista with a Gravitum basic attack, then root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If several enemies are grouped, use Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil with Gravitum as your main weapon for an area slow, then follow with a root.
Kalista.escape: While Kalista R Fate's Call is down, there is less need to watch for her support's engage, so look for a chance to root her. Keep watching for leaps from Kalista P Martial Poise, but if you catch her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites after a Gravitum slow, do not delay your engage.
Kalista.phase: Aphelios has few clear early power spikes, so farm while avoiding stacks of Kalista's spears. In the mid and late game, choose fights based on your core items and current weapon combination. The available information does not establish which champion is stronger.
Kalista.teamfight: Attack from behind your frontline and spread out when Kalista prepares to pull in her support with Kalista R Fate's Call. With Gravitum, stop Kalista's leaps using the slow from Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. With Infernum, deal area damage to grouped enemies, but do not move ahead when your weapon combination is unsuitable.

MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces behind minions, so do not stand in line with one. When Miss Fortune E Make It Rain lands, move out of its area; Miss Fortune R Bullet Time may follow while you are slowed. Once the barrage starts, move to the side of its cone or interrupt it with the Gravitum root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.
MissFortune.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Miss Fortune deals mainly physical damage, and Aphelios has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Armor does not reduce the magic damage from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain.
MissFortune.fight: With Calibrum, Aphelios uses marks to keep his distance while trading, and avoids starting a head-on fight during this phase, when his immediate burst is low. Right after Miss Fortune last-hits a minion, create distance to avoid her empowered poke. When you have Gravitum and an ally closes the gap, chain its slow into a root to catch Miss Fortune, who has no mobility spell.
MissFortune.laning: Farm while minimizing losses early, and check the display for Aphelios E Weapon Queue System to prepare your next weapon combination. Poke with Calibrum, clear waves with Infernum, and add a root when your support or jungler engages while you have Gravitum. With any weapon, avoid standing directly behind a minion that Miss Fortune Q Double Up can bounce from.
MissFortune.combo: Make Gravitum your main weapon, slow Miss Fortune with a basic attack, then root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. When you need to interrupt Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, use Aphelios W Phase to make Gravitum your main weapon, then follow the slow from Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil with the Gravitum root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility ability, so look for a chance to close the gap with your allies from outside the area of Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. Delay your engage while you are in that area and draw Miss Fortune out of it.
MissFortune.phase: In the mid game, look for fights once you have core items and the right weapon combination. Even in late teamfights, decide when to fight based on the angles for Miss Fortune E Make It Rain and Miss Fortune R Bullet Time and Aphelios's current weapon combination, rather than assuming either champion is overwhelmingly stronger.
MissFortune.teamfight: Attack from behind your frontline as Aphelios, and do not start a fight in the area of Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, move to the side of its cone or interrupt the channel with a Gravitum root. If enemies are grouped, use Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil with Infernum as your main weapon to deal area damage.

Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, it destroys projectiles and basic attacks, so attack after it ends. If the enemy support's crowd control hits you, Samira P Daredevil Impulse can let her close in immediately, so dodge the engage ability first. If Samira gets close and lands different types of attacks, she can use Samira R Inferno Trigger; create distance to interrupt that buildup.
Samira.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Samira deals mainly physical damage, and Aphelios has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Samira.fight: With Calibrum, use marks to poke from outside Samira's range and avoid a direct fight because your immediate damage is low. If Samira E Wild Rush has been used and no one has died, counterattack by landing the Gravitum root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Use projectiles and basic attacks after Samira W Blade Whirl ends.
Samira.laning: Focus on farming without taking losses early, and control the angles from which Samira can walk in. With Calibrum, poke without closing in. With Infernum, clear the wave to gain lane control. With Gravitum, add a root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites when your support or jungler engages.
Samira.combo: Apply a slow with a Gravitum basic attack first. If Gravitum is your offhand weapon, use Aphelios W Phase to bring it forward, then root with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Before using Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil, use Aphelios W Phase to put Gravitum in your main hand so you can follow its area slow with a root. If Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, hold projectile attacks until it ends.
Samira.escape: Right after you force Samira E Wild Rush is your window to close the gap or catch her out. Go in once you have avoided the enemy support's crowd control, and use a Gravitum slow and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to cut short the time Samira can stay close.
Samira.teamfight: Attack from behind your frontline and dodge the enemy support's engage ability first. If an ally is immobilized, Samira P Daredevil Impulse can let her close in on them, so prepare Gravitum to root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. When Samira R Inferno Trigger starts, interrupt it with an immobilizing effect. As you retreat, do not leave a low health ally behind.

Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you are slowed, move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine. In teamfights, spread out sideways because Seraphine R Encore's charm can extend farther through allies.
Seraphine.build: Build magic resistance against Seraphine's damage. If the enemy has a lot of immobilizing crowd control, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier. If Seraphine W Surround Sound's healing is a problem, add Mortal Reminder.
Seraphine.fight: With Calibrum, use the marks from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to poke while keeping your distance. Close in and trade when Seraphine is separated from your allied ADC or immediately after she misses Seraphine E Beat Drop. Before engaging, check your current weapon and the next weapon shown by Aphelios E Weapon Queue System.
Seraphine.laning: Farm early while minimizing losses, and manage the wave around your weapon rotation. Poke with Calibrum, clear waves with Infernum, and follow an ally's engage with a root from Gravitum. If your weapon combination is unfavorable, watch for Seraphine E Beat Drop and manage your ammo.
Seraphine.combo: If Seraphine E Beat Drop is down and you have Gravitum, use Aphelios W Phase to make Gravitum your main weapon. Slow with Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil, then root with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If you first slow with a Gravitum basic attack, you can root immediately with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.
Seraphine.escape: Right after Seraphine E Beat Drop is used is your chance to close the gap. Seraphine has no mobility skill, so once you are close, hold her with Gravitum's slow and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Aphelios also has limited ways to escape on his own, so check the distance before going in.
Seraphine.phase: Aphelios has few clear early level spikes, so focus on farming while minimizing losses. In mid game, look for fights after you have core items and Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. In late game, attack from behind your frontline according to your weapon combination; the given information is insufficient to judge which champion is stronger late.
Seraphine.teamfight: Attack from behind your frontline and spread out sideways so Seraphine R Encore does not pass through multiple allies. With Gravitum, slow using Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil or a basic attack, then root with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. With Infernum, deal area damage to grouped enemies while keeping enough distance to avoid being hit by Seraphine E Beat Drop and caught afterward.

Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through targets, so move out of any straight line connecting Senna with a minion or ally. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions; if it hits you, move away from allies before the root triggers. If Senna hits you once, back off to deny a second attack and prevent her from collecting mist through Senna P Absolution.
Senna.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Senna's main damage is physical and Aphelios has low armor, so build armor first. If the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness is a problem, add Mortal Reminder.
Senna.fight: During your Calibrum rotation, trade using marks from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites while keeping your distance. If you dodge Senna W Last Embrace and an ally closes the gap, apply Gravitum's slow, then follow with a root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. When your weapon combination is unfavorable, manage your ammo instead of starting a fight.
Senna.laning: Watch where souls appear and poke Senna when she steps forward to collect them. Avoid the path of Senna Q Piercing Darkness and block Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions. Poke during your Calibrum rotation and clear waves during your Infernum rotation; check the display on Aphelios E Weapon Queue System to prepare the weapons you need for the next fight.
Senna.combo: If Gravitum is your main weapon, slow Senna with a basic attack first, then root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If Gravitum is your off-hand weapon, bring it forward with Aphelios W Phase and use Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. When several enemies group up, make Gravitum your main weapon with Aphelios W Phase, then follow the area slow from Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil with the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace misses is your chance to close the gap. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist is active, camouflaged enemies may approach with her, so back off first and fight again where you have vision.
Senna.phase: Senna has very low health early, so you can pressure her when she steps forward to collect souls, but Aphelios should farm without taking losses and manage his weapons. In mid game, look for fights suited to your weapon combination after Aphelios has items. In late game, Senna gains range and attack damage if she collects enough mist, so denying her collection from the laning phase is important.
Senna.teamfight: Attack from behind your frontline at a range your current weapon can reach. When you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, back off to gain vision or use an area attack such as Infernum's Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to deny an engage. If enemies group up, look for an area root with Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil while Gravitum is your main weapon, followed by Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.

Sivir.watch: Watch the path of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and dodge both its outward and return passes. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one skill, so check that it has been used before casting Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites or Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, her whole team moves faster, so do not chase or take a prolonged fight.
Sivir.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. The main damage from Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet is physical, and Aphelios has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Sivir.fight: With Calibrum, use marks from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to poke while keeping your distance. Bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then start a fight with the slow from a Gravitum basic attack and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. When your weapon combination is unfavorable, manage your ammo instead of forcing a fight.
Sivir.laning: Focus on farming without taking losses early. Poke during your Calibrum rotation and clear waves during your Infernum rotation. Sivir clears waves quickly, so if you need to leave lane, push first or have an ally ready to catch the wave. During your Gravitum rotation, time your root with an engage from your support or jungler.
Sivir.combo: Bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then use Aphelios W Phase to bring Gravitum forward as your main weapon. Apply its slow with a basic attack and root with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If several enemies are grouped in a fight, follow the area slow from Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil with Gravitum as your main weapon with a root.
Sivir.escape: Go in when Sivir E Spell Shield is down and Sivir R On The Hunt is inactive. Sivir has no blink or skill that lets her create distance on her own, so add a Gravitum root when an ally closes the gap.
Sivir.phase: Watch for Sivir's fast wave clear early while Aphelios minimizes losses through farming. Look for fights once Aphelios has core items, and prepare for objectives after pushing the lane with Infernum. In late game teamfights, provide Gravitum roots or Infernum area damage according to your weapon combination.
Sivir.teamfight: Aphelios attacks from behind his frontline. While Sivir R On The Hunt is active, take only short fights using terrain and vision. Once Sivir E Spell Shield is down, catch enemies with the area slow from Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil while Gravitum is your main weapon, followed by the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If you have Infernum, deal area damage to grouped enemies.

Smolder.watch: If Smolder W Achooo! hits you, its slow makes follow-up attacks easier to land, so stand behind minions or dodge sideways. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at its center and heals Smolder, so leave its area and fight again afterward. As Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath gains stacks, its true damage and execute become dangerous.
Smolder.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against Smolder's damage, but account for the fact that armor cannot block the true damage from Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. If the healing from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! is a problem, add Mortal Reminder.
Smolder.fight: When Aphelios has Calibrum, apply marks with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to trade damage while keeping your distance. Right after Smolder uses Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, apply a slow with a Gravitum basic attack, then root with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites and pressure him with your allies.
Smolder.laning: Poke Smolder from early on to slow the growth of Smolder P Dragon Practice and reduce his chances to kill minions with Q. Poke during your Calibrum rotation, clear waves during your Infernum rotation, and root in time with an engage from your support or jungler during your Gravitum rotation. When your weapon combination is unfavorable, farm without overextending and manage your ammo.
Smolder.combo: When Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, apply a slow with a Gravitum basic attack. If Gravitum is your off-hand weapon, switch it to your main weapon with Aphelios W Phase, then root with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. When several enemies group up, apply an area slow with Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil while Gravitum is your main weapon, then follow with a root.
Smolder.escape: Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap lets him escape over terrain, so right after he uses it is your chance to go in. Save your Gravitum root and Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil until then, dodge the slow from Smolder W Achooo!, and close the gap.
Smolder.phase: Early game, before Smolder has built up stacks, is the best time to pressure him. Aphelios should avoid major farming losses early while using poke to disrupt Smolder's CS, then pressure objectives and towers in mid game once he has core items. Smolder grows stronger over time, so the same engage opportunities are harder to find late.
Smolder.teamfight: Aphelios attacks from behind his frontline, avoiding the center of Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! and the healing area beneath Smolder. During your Gravitum rotation, look for an area root with Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil and Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites; during your Infernum rotation, deal area damage to grouped enemies. Once Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, focus Smolder with your allies.

Tristana.watch: Tristana W Rocket Jump is a dash that slows, and its cooldown resets when she contributes to a takedown. Do not commit while both Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are ready. Keep your distance from allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge.
Tristana.fight: With Calibrum, use Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to mark Tristana, then follow up from range to chip away at her health. Once Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, apply Gravitum's slow and use Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to root her and start a fight. If your weapon combination is unfavorable, stay back and manage your ammo.
Tristana.laning: Farm while minimizing losses early. Poke with Calibrum and push the lane with Infernum. Pushing the lane toward Tristana's turret makes it harder for her to last-hit. Do not stand close to allied minions, so damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge does not spread to you.
Tristana.combo: First apply Gravitum's slow to Tristana. If needed, use Aphelios W Phase to make Gravitum your main weapon, then root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. To root multiple enemies, make Gravitum your main weapon with Aphelios W Phase, slow them with Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil, then follow up with the root.
Tristana.escape: Right after you force Tristana W Rocket Jump is a chance to close the gap or catch her out. Delay your engage while both Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are ready. Prepare a root before going in.
Tristana.phase: Tristana is weak early, but Aphelios should also farm while avoiding losses. In the mid game, look for fights that suit your weapon combination once Aphelios has his core items. Aim to end the game before Tristana completes her build, when she becomes difficult to handle.
Tristana.teamfight: Attack from behind your frontline. Use Gravitum to root enemies or Infernum to attack grouped enemies. Tristana W Rocket Jump resets when she contributes to a takedown, so retreat immediately if an ally falls and your team starts losing the fight. Do not leave a vulnerable ally in front as you retreat.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, stay out of his attack range: one basic attack will stun you.
TwistedFate.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Twisted Fate's damage. If the enemy team has a lot of immobilizing crowd control, buy Quicksilver Sash earlier.
TwistedFate.fight: With Calibrum, trade damage while keeping your distance using the mark from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. When Twisted Fate has used the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card or Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, slow him with a Gravitum basic attack, then root and attack him with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.
TwistedFate.laning: Focus on farming without taking losses early, and take Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards from behind minions. Poke with Calibrum, clear waves with Infernum, and use Gravitum's root to follow up on an ally's engage.
TwistedFate.combo: Slow Twisted Fate with a Gravitum basic attack. If needed, use Aphelios W Phase to make Gravitum your main weapon, then root him with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. To catch multiple enemies with Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil, select Gravitum as your main weapon before casting it, then follow up with the root.
TwistedFate.escape: Right after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, you also have a chance to close in without worrying about the stun.
TwistedFate.phase: Later, look for fights once Aphelios has his items, and choose your role based on the weapons you are holding.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Attack from behind your frontline, and do not enter the range of the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card carelessly. With Gravitum, apply its slow, then root with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. With Infernum, deal area damage to grouped enemies. If you see Twisted Fate use Twisted Fate R Destiny and he is in range, interrupt his travel with a root.

Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if at least three returning feathers hit, so watch the line between Xayah and the feathers on the ground. If three or more feathers lie along their return path, step sideways instead of retreating straight back. If Xayah R Featherstorm is available, Aphelios's abilities may miss; wait for her to use it before attacking.
Xayah.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Xayah's main damage is physical and Aphelios has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Xayah.fight: Keep trades short and reposition so the feathers from Xayah E Bladecaller do not pile up along one return path. With Calibrum, use the mark from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to poke from a distance. Once Xayah R Featherstorm is down, look for a fight by applying Gravitum's slow and following up with a root.
Xayah.laning: Farm while minimizing losses early, and check the next weapon shown by Aphelios E Weapon Queue System to prepare your weapon combination for the fight. Poke with Calibrum and clear waves with Infernum. With Gravitum, follow up on your support's or jungler's engage with a root, but do not linger in the path of Xayah's returning feathers.
Xayah.combo: After Xayah R Featherstorm is down, slow her with a Gravitum basic attack. If needed, use Aphelios W Phase to make Gravitum your main weapon, then root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Before using Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil, also select your main weapon with Aphelios W Phase. With Gravitum as your main weapon, follow up with an area slow and root; with Infernum, follow up with area damage.
Xayah.escape: After stepping sideways out of the return path of Xayah E Bladecaller's feathers, you can safely apply pressure by following up on an ally's engage with Gravitum's root.
Xayah.phase: The given information is insufficient to determine which champion is stronger in the mid or late game. Once Aphelios has his items, fight according to your weapon combination and whether Xayah has used Xayah R Featherstorm.
Xayah.teamfight: Attack from behind your frontline. If Xayah R Featherstorm is available, do not rush to use Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil or a root on her. Once she uses Xayah R Featherstorm, create an area root with Gravitum or deal area damage to grouped enemies with Infernum. Keep watching the line between Xayah and her feathers, and step sideways out of the root path.

Varus.watch: If you are marked with stacks from Varus W Blighted Quiver, an ability hit triggers damage based on your maximum health. After taking a few basic attacks, retreat and buy time for the stacks to expire. If you see Varus aim Varus Q Piercing Arrow, sidestep or stand behind minions. Leave the area of Varus E Hail of Arrows before healing. If an ally is hit by Varus R Chain of Corruption, move away so its tendrils cannot reach you.
Varus.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against Varus's main damage and basic attacks. Also account for the maximum health based damage from Varus W Blighted Quiver and the reduced healing inside Varus E Hail of Arrows.
Varus.fight: With Calibrum, trade damage while keeping your distance using the mark from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. While Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, sidestep and look for a chance to close the gap. If you have Gravitum, apply its slow, then root Varus with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites; he has no ability to create distance.
Varus.laning: Focus on farming while minimizing losses early, rather than forcing fights. Poke with Calibrum, and clear waves with Infernum to gain lane priority. With Gravitum, follow up on your support's or jungler's engage with a root. If your weapon combination is unfavorable, manage your ammo and wait.
Varus.combo: Slow Varus with a Gravitum basic attack, then root him with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If multiple enemies are grouped, make Infernum your main weapon and look to deal area damage with Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil.
Varus.escape: Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so dodge the path of Varus Q Piercing Arrow while he aims it and close the gap. Avoid being rooted by Varus R Chain of Corruption. Once it is down, catch him with Gravitum's slow and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.
Varus.phase: Aphelios has few clear power spikes early, so build armor and focus on farming. Once you have your core items, set up a suitable weapon combination and look for fights. The given information is insufficient to determine which side is stronger in the mid or late game.
Varus.teamfight: Attack from behind your frontline, and keep your distance from allies so Varus R Chain of Corruption does not spread between you. Create an area root with Gravitum, or deal area damage to grouped enemies with Infernum and Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil. While Varus has increased attack speed and attack damage after a kill or assist, do not close in; wait for that period to pass.

Twitch.watch: Twitch Q Ambush lets him approach from outside vision, so alert your team when he disappears and avoid brush and narrow paths where you have no vision. If Twitch W Venom Cask hits you, leave the cloud immediately. If you have taken several basic attacks, create distance before Twitch E Contaminate hits, even if you still have health. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, account for its increased range and avoid lining up with allies.
Twitch.build: Get a Control Ward early to prepare for Twitch Q Ambush. Twitch E Contaminate deals two types of damage, and Twitch P Deadly Venom deals true damage, so do not rely on one type of resistance alone. Consider more health and ways to reduce attack speed.
Twitch.fight: With Calibrum, trade at a distance using marks from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites and avoid direct fights. Once Twitch Q Ambush ends and reveals his position, use Gravitum's slow and root to focus him with your team.
Twitch.laning: Early on, focus on farming without taking unfavorable trades. Poke with Calibrum and clear waves with Infernum. If Twitch disappears from lane, warn that he may roam to another lane. Check paths without vision with a Control Ward before passing through. When you have Gravitum, time your root with an engage from your support or jungler.
Twitch.combo: When Twitch Q Ambush ends and reveals him, use Aphelios W Phase to make Gravitum your main weapon. Slow him with Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil, then root him with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites so your team can focus him.
Twitch.escape: Leave the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask, then engage once Twitch Q Ambush ends and his position is known. Twitch has no ability to create distance on his own, so landing Gravitum's root gives your team a chance to kill him.
Twitch.teamfight: Position behind your frontline and spread sideways so you and your allies do not get hit by the same piercing attacks from Twitch R Spray and Pray. When Twitch Q Ambush ends, or when he activates Twitch R Spray and Pray and takes position, land Gravitum's slow and root and focus the same target as your team. If you have Infernum, deal area damage to grouped enemies.

Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads over a wide area when it hits terrain, so do not stand with your back to a wall or face her in a narrow passage. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther over walls, so force her into open terrain if you want to catch her. Zeri R Lightning Crash increases her movement speed; do not chase on foot. Stop her with Gravitum's root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. At low health, watch for the execute from Zeri P Living Battery.
Zeri.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against the physical damage from Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Armor does not block the magic damage from Zeri P Living Battery and Zeri E Spark Surge, and if you only greatly increase your health, the damage you take based on maximum health also increases.
Zeri.fight: Use Calibrum marks from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to trade from beyond Zeri's short range. Right after she uses Zeri E Spark Surge, close the gap in open terrain, slow her with a Gravitum basic attack, then root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Do not force a direct fight with an unfavorable weapon combination or before you have items.
Zeri.combo: After Zeri E Spark Surge is used, slow her with a Gravitum basic attack and root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If Gravitum is your off-hand weapon, bring it out with Aphelios W Phase before using Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. To root multiple enemies, keep Gravitum as your main weapon, land Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil, then follow with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.
Zeri.escape: Zeri E Spark Surge is her only mobility ability, so the moment after you make her use it is your opening to engage. Once Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, do not chase unless you can root her immediately.
Zeri.phase: Early on, take advantage of Zeri's short range to poke with Calibrum, but prioritize farming safely as Aphelios. Once you have core items in the mid game, look for fights while Zeri E Spark Surge is on cooldown. As Zeri becomes more mobile over time, she gets harder to catch, so deal damage from behind your frontline in the late game instead of chasing too far.
Zeri.teamfight: Position behind your frontline and avoid spots where Zeri W Ultrashock Laser can spread from a wall. When Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, do not follow her; pin her down with Gravitum's slow and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Against grouped enemies, deal area damage with Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil while Infernum is your main weapon.
Zeri.laning: While holding Calibrum, punish Zeri’s short range to build a lead before core items come online. During the Infernum phase, clear the wave; during the Gravitum phase, follow up an engage from your support or jungler with a root. Track the next weapon shown in Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and manage your ammo.

Vayne.watch: Do not fight with your back to a wall, where Vayne E Condemn can push you into it and stun you. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage based on maximum health when she repeatedly hits the same target, so track how many hits you have taken and leave her range before it triggers. During Vayne R Final Hour, she briefly becomes invisible after Vayne Q Tumble; attack when she reappears.
Vayne.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against the physical damage from Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn. Armor will not reduce the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts.
Vayne.fight: With Calibrum, trade at a distance using marks from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Right after Vayne uses Vayne Q Tumble, slow her with a Gravitum attack and root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to start a fight. If you have Severum, account for having no way out after using Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.
Vayne.laning: Pressure Vayne while her early health and armor are low to disrupt her farming. Poke with Calibrum, push waves with Infernum, and add Gravitum's root to an ally's engage. Check your next weapon with Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and do not force a fight with an unfavorable combination.
Vayne.combo: Once Vayne Q Tumble is used, make Gravitum your main weapon with Aphelios W Phase. Slow her with a Gravitum attack, then root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If several enemies are together, you can slow them with Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil while Gravitum is your main weapon, then root them with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites.
Vayne.escape: The moment after you make Vayne use Vayne Q Tumble is your chance to close the gap. Fight in the open because Vayne E Condemn can stun you near a wall, and use the opening if Vayne E Condemn has been used.
Vayne.phase: Pressure Vayne's low early health and armor, while focusing on farming without losses and managing Aphelios's weapons. Once Aphelios has core items in the mid game, push the lane with Infernum and look for objectives and towers. Vayne becomes harder to face in the late game when she has attack speed and penetration items, so carry your early and mid game gains forward.
Vayne.teamfight: Attack from behind your frontline and fight in open areas rather than narrow passages where Vayne E Condemn can push you into a wall. With Gravitum, apply a slow, then root with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. With Infernum, deal area damage to grouped enemies. During Vayne R Final Hour, wait for her to reappear after turning invisible with Vayne Q Tumble before attacking.

Ziggs.watch: Stepping on Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield slows you and makes his follow-up abilities harder to dodge, so take a path without mines or wait for them to disappear. When the warning area for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb appears, move away from the center of the blast even if you cannot leave the area entirely.
Ziggs.build: Early on, farm while minimizing losses and look for fights after you get core items. The source does not specify a first purchase, but if you build resistance against Ziggs's magic damage, choose magic resistance.
Ziggs.fight: With Calibrum, trade at a distance using marks from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites, and avoid direct fights because your immediate damage is low. After Ziggs W Satchel Charge is used, apply Gravitum's slow, follow with the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites, and close the gap.
Ziggs.laning: Early on, focus on farming and ammo management instead of forcing fights. Poke with Calibrum and clear waves with Infernum, but do not enter a path blocked by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. Before the next fight, check the display for Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and prepare the weapon combination you need.
Ziggs.combo: If Gravitum is your off-hand weapon, make it your main weapon with Aphelios W Phase, then root with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. In a fight with several grouped enemies, you can use Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil with Gravitum as your main weapon to apply an area slow, then follow with a root.
Ziggs.escape: The moment after Ziggs uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge to poke or clear a wave is your opening to engage. Avoid paths covered by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, check his escape route over a wall, then land Gravitum's root.
Ziggs.phase: From the mid game onward, look for fights when you have core items and a suitable weapon combination. The source does not establish which side is stronger in the late game, so fight according to your position and weapon combination in teamfights.
Ziggs.teamfight: Attack from behind your frontline. Around objectives, do not group so closely that several allies get hit by Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb. Once Ziggs W Satchel Charge is used, root with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites while holding Gravitum. If enemies are grouped, look for area damage with Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil while Infernum is your main weapon.

Nilah.watch: Right after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, Nilah gains attack range and area of effect, so step back farther. While Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, basic attacks miss; stop using basic attacks and wait for it to expire. If Nilah R Apotheosis pulls in several allies, the enemy heals, so spread out from your team while her ultimate is available.
Nilah.build: Most of Nilah’s damage is physical, so start with Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps. Nilah Q Formless Blade has armor penetration, so build health alongside armor. If Nilah’s healing becomes a problem, add Mortal Reminder.
Nilah.fight: While holding Calibrum, stay out of Nilah E Slipstream’s engage range and trade from a distance with marks from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. After Nilah engages and has fully expended Nilah W Jubilant Veil, lock her down with Gravitum’s slow and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Nilah E Slipstream has a short cooldown, so do not overcommit just because her mobility ability alone has been expended.
Nilah.laning: Poke while holding Calibrum, clear waves while holding Infernum, and add a root to your team’s engage while holding Gravitum. Check the next weapon shown by Aphelios E Weapon Queue System, and manage your ammo without forcing a fight when the weapon combination is unfavorable.
Nilah.combo: When Nilah engages and has fully expended Nilah W Jubilant Veil, apply Gravitum’s slow with a basic attack. If needed, use Aphelios W Phase to make Gravitum your main weapon, then root her with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If several enemies engage together, hit them with Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil while Gravitum is your main weapon to apply an area slow, then follow with a root.
Nilah.escape: Look to engage when both Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil have been fully expended. Nilah E Slipstream has a short cooldown, though, so chain the slow from a Gravitum basic attack into the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites before fighting. If Nilah R Apotheosis is available, do not engage while grouped with your allies.

Nilah.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Nilah R Apotheosis cannot catch several of you, and attack from behind your frontline. When Nilah engages and has fully expended Nilah W Jubilant Veil, lock her down with Gravitum’s slow and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo lands Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice in a row, his next Q launches a knockup whirlwind. Once he has those stacks, move out of its line and dodge sideways. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him approach through minions, so do not stand among them. When Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, go around it or save key abilities until it disappears.
Yasuo.build: Most of Yasuo’s damage is physical, and Aphelios has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.fight: Remove the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with light poke before trading. With Calibrum, use marks from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites to poke while keeping your distance, and avoid direct fights. Right after the whirlwind from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest misses, follow your allies’ crowd control with a Gravitum root.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin and pushing toward your side to give Yasuo E Sweeping Blade fewer minions to use for his approach. Poke with Calibrum, clear waves with Infernum, and follow your support’s or jungler’s engage with Gravitum. Check the indicator for Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and manage your ammo so you have the weapons you need for the next fight.
Yasuo.combo: If Yasuo W Wind Wall has disappeared and Gravitum is your off hand weapon, use Aphelios W Phase to make it your main weapon. Apply a slow with a Gravitum basic attack, then root with Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil also applies an area slow when Gravitum is your main weapon, so you can follow a hit with a Q root.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo fires the whirlwind from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest is an opening to engage. Engage with your allies’ crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up, and hold him with Aphelios’s Gravitum root. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can be used again, so do not chase in just because he used one dash.
Yasuo.phase: In the early game, Aphelios has trouble escaping once caught, so farm while minimizing losses. The information provided does not establish which side has the advantage in the mid or late game.
Yasuo.teamfight: Keep your distance behind your frontline and watch for minion paths Yasuo can use to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. With Gravitum, time the slow from Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites with your allies’ engage. With Infernum, deal area damage to grouped enemies.
